subject.title: Models: fully dynamic model discovery (OpenRouter + beyond)

question: How should dynamically fetched OpenRouter text models be filtered and authorized in normal pickers and `/model` flows?
rationale: The runtime and fetch primitives exist, but acceptable catalog size, capability defaults, cost safeguards, allowlist authority, and offline fallback are product choices that source inspection cannot settle.

options.title: Curated live catalog
options.body: Fetch current models, show a bounded recommended subset by default, expose the full set through explicit search or all-catalog views, and keep configured allowlists authoritative.

options.title: Full live catalog
options.body: Show every fetched model in normal list and picker surfaces, accepting a large and rapidly changing selection experience.

options.title: Runtime fallback only
options.body: Keep arbitrary configured models executable but leave normal discovery static, preserving the primary user-facing gap.

recommendation.title: Curated live catalog
recommendation.body: Fetch current models, show a bounded recommended subset by default, expose the full set through explicit search or all-catalog views, and keep configured allowlists authoritative.

likelyOwner.reason: Josh Palmer is the current assignee and authored the unresolved policy questions.
